Definition: Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Gibʻâh is a place, named 42 times in Scripture, in Joshua, Judges, and 1 Samuel. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Gibʻâh, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
